reason: I need chutney when I'm prepping snacks, not after waiting 3 days for a courier delivery from a website when the local kirana has bottles on shelf right now.
objection: Waiting days for online delivery of a staple condiment is impractical when kirana stores have instant alternatives.
would_change_my_mind: Instant delivery on 10-minute apps like Zepto/Blinkit and a price closer to ₹50.
